Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: usable transparent in-game PIXEL ART animation atlas, NOT an illustration sheet, poster or game screenshot.
Input image is an IDENTITY/COSTUME/PIXEL-STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Recreate its adult female swordfighter LIRIAN as a compact top-down RPG sprite: long pale silver-pink hair with a small red rose ornament, pink-red eyes, fitted black steel/leather armor/corset with silver metallic trim, armored gloves, black thigh-high boots, deep crimson short split cape/coattails, ONE slender one-handed silver sword with red accents. Same character and outfit throughout. Show the complete armored costume, never undress the character. No hood, no teal hunter, no fur coat, no greatsword.
Follow the small IN-GAME PIXEL CHARACTER drawings in the bottom/right of the reference rather than the large portrait. Crisp dark pixel outlines, chunky readable pixel clusters and restrained shading, about 72 pixels head-to-feet at sprite scale, compact RPG proportions, NOT smooth high-resolution anime painting. Make the character readable on a dark olive carapace environment.
EXACTLY FIVE equal rows and SIX equal columns, 30 isolated sprites total. True transparent RGBA background, no background, floor, shadows, labels, letters, borders, effects, petals, motion trails, other characters or detached weapons.
Row order TOP TO BOTTOM: SOUTH/front facing viewer; SOUTHEAST/front-right 3/4; EAST/right profile; NORTHEAST/rear-right 3/4 facing away; NORTH/true back facing away with no face visible. Keep fixed elevated 3/4 game camera, never rotate the whole bitmap in plane. Rightward rows face RIGHT. Character keeps the SAME direction within each row and animates in place.
Layout: identical body scale in all cells. Feet centered on same fixed baseline at 84% of each cell's height. Body occupies around 48% of cell height so the raised/extended sword fits. Large transparent gutters: the entire character INCLUDING HAIR, CAPE and SWORD remains inside the central 74% of each cell, separated from all neighboring sprites and canvas edges. Don't crop, touch or overlap cells. Same hair length, sword length and body proportions across poses. Face remains expressive but tiny. Sword is held only in right hand, left hand balances, no extra sword or limbs.
Primary request: idle and walking. Columns 1–2 are two distinct relaxed IDLE breathing poses, sword lowered at right side, subtle hair/cape settle. Columns 3–6 are four chronological LOOPING WALK keyframes: left foot forward, passing feet, right foot forward, passing feet opposite phase. Clear alternating knees/feet and natural counterbalancing arm/hair movement. Do not lunge, attack or raise sword. Every row has the same two-idle/four-walk order.
